racket.heading: Pick up the racket.
racket.text: Padel rackets have no strings: the face is solid and perforated. This one is modelled in code, with the 21 dots of the Volea logo as its holes. Drag to turn it — then take it on court.
racket.canvasLabel: A 3D padel racket with a carbon face whose holes form the Volea logo's dot grid, turning slowly while a ball bounces off it.

rally.heading: Feel the glass.
rally.text: Padel lives off the glass: after one bounce the ball may come back off the wall and stay in play. Watch the rally, practise without points, or play a quick match against the computer.
rally.note: Real court dimensions and padel rules; floor bounce per the FIP ball spec, walls approximated. Shown in gentle slow motion, with the ball and rackets drawn larger.
rally.canvasLabel: Padel court seen from the side: two teams of two rackets rally across the net, and the ball rebounds off the back glass walls.
rally.controls: Keyboard: ← → run, Space serves and jumps, Escape quits. Phone: drag to run, tap to serve or jump. The game pauses while a card is open.
rally.controlsTouch: Practice and Play match open full screen, with buttons to run, serve and jump. The game pauses while a card is open.

fullscreen.rotateText: The court is wide, so the game plays in landscape. It waits, paused, until you turn.

calls.offTheGlass: Off the glass — still in play

tutorial.hit: Run into the ball, towards the net
tutorial.free: Free practice — no points. Run into the ball, jump for high ones.
